title: Dysfunction Following Thyroid Surgery
brief_summary: Voice plays a crucial role in human communication and function. Voice production is multidimensional, involving physiologic, biomechanical, and aerodynamic mechanisms that produce an acoustic output that is perceived by the auditory system. So its important to evaluate patients with voice disorders, whenever possible, to characterize the impact of the disorder(s) on all of the pertinent mechanisms/dimensions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* benign and malignant thyroid disease normal voice controlled thyroid hormones level

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age below 18 years any cardiac, renal,hepatic, respiratory, mental can interfere with the surgery any voice changes due to any cause before surgery previous head and neck surgery neurological dysfunctions
